who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executors of plan 12 E2, E2a, E2a-1, E2a-2, E2a-3 and E2a-4, int-1112
what: The imports, stability and dead-code passes resolve every path of the crate through hir::view::Semantics over the live tree (vsema.scope per path in used.rs, resolve_path at 27 sites in stability/walk.rs, 19 in dead/defs.rs), so no memo of theirs holds across a body edit of the file and a six body edit pays 5,672 analyze_impl spans. Meanwhile dead/mark/body.rs already resolves a body's paths from the expression store, inference and one Resolver, with a test that this equals what Semantics finds: three passes, two resolution paths for one concept.
cost: the bulk of 20.4 ms of crate passes on every body edit (plan 12 section 0); E2 could not be ported in one context
cause: the passes were written against the syntax walk every syntax pass shares, and the HIR resolution of a body was built later inside one pass instead of as the shared home
class: one concept (what a path names) with two homes, the slower one position-bound
prevention: one home: lints/names/uses.rs resolves body paths from HIR for every pass; a ban on vsema.resolve_path inside lints/names once E2a-c land
fix: E2a step 1 written, uncompiled (2026-11-12): the body path resolution lifted into lints/names/uses.rs (BodyPaths::resolve). Found: hir-def already has the whole fact (nameres/uses.rs used_imports, hir_ty::used_imports_with_traits, equal to the walk by used.rs's own test what_the_walk_finds_used_is_what_the_front_end_records): the end state is the imports lint reading that query, not a third resolution. E2a-2 written, uncompiled (2026-11-12): the front end's record is per body (hir-def nameres/uses.rs body_uses, hir-ty used_imports body_trait_uses; crate_uses and used_imports_with_traits only fold records, test a_body_edit_with_equal_uses_reruns_no_fold) and holds typeck and #[macro_use] names apart; the lint does not read it yet.
